## Change

Describe the behavior, scope and compatibility impact.

## Verification

List exact commands and results, including failures and checks not run. For
conversion changes, distinguish editable structure, Adobe inspection and render
comparison, and import from export. Do not treat a round trip as Adobe proof.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Added a regression for a bug fix, without weakening existing coverage.
- [ ] Kept the standalone workspace and export inventory consistent.
- [ ] Listed any dependency, parser-limit, public API or format change.
- [ ] Identified adapted code and retained its license/copyright notices.
- [ ] Recorded redistribution permission and metadata review for new fixtures.
- [ ] Preserved pinned sources/references, or identified a new revision and proof.
- [ ] Have authority to submit original contributions under MIT, including any
      required employer/client permission.

For a security vulnerability, follow SECURITY.md instead of opening a public PR
with exploit details or sensitive source files.
